qualification.basis: Test profile for the next public square run. Built from the e01 copies (materialization, bridge, export flag, container fields, ModifiedDate, caret for List 0 / Para 0), the g01 Save(False) method observation and the h01 line cache of one single-line paragraph. Not observed: a public picture Save, external edited output, close, reopen, a preview change under an edit, replacement allocation and picture history.

materialization.basis: Four SaveAs(path,"HWPX","lock:false;export") completions behind the production exact-True guard; working Path, caret and empty selection unchanged; complete 12-member packages. No separate raw-return logger.

bridge.basis: Product bridge on all four actual HWPML2X producer strings and HWPX copies: one body picture; frame, position, crop, dimensions and media digest agree; the native control census secd, cold, gso matches. Multi-picture, rich, shared and post-edit censuses were not observed.

export_native_dirty.basis: IsModified false->false (clean) and true->false (dirty, undo, redo) across the export.

container_volatile.basis: Every ZIP container field and the member order are identical across the four copies (date_time 1980-01-01 00:00:00).

regenerated_members.basis: Previews are identical for identical content and change with body text (724x1024 PNG throughout); never observed under a picture edit.

volatile_values.basis: Clean->undo and dirty->redo differ only in content.hpf ModifiedDate text; every value is an exact UTC second inside the witness-derived write window of its own copy.

caret.basis: settings.xml CaretPosition listIDRef/paraIDRef/pos equals native GetPos (0,0,24) and (0,0,65); only List 0 and Para 0 were observed.

replacement_manifest_attributes.basis: The actual image manifest item also carries hashkey, which is not MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 of the member bytes; its new-item value cannot be derived, so new-allocation replacement is refused under this candidate.

public_save.basis: g01 actual public body insertion at current typed caret, private SaveAs true-to-false, ONE exact-True Save(False), complete current601 saved package comparison. Method-limited, not public picture Save. Receipt SHA256 afa780d32ff0590ad3217073a3e5472e59bfb3c6e596d903c482f0ecb985c7e4

history.basis: Only one public body type/Undo/Redo was observed (native_undo_steps 1); no picture Undo/Redo. No picture kind is declared.

line_reflow.basis: h01 actual private copies 655a37fed3ba6348 (before) and 83b21ab0fb914aef (after) of one genuine public picture_layout_exact(square) on an inline TopAndBottom picture: only the picture's own single-line paragraph lineseg baseline, horzpos, horzsize, textheight and vertsize changed; textpos, vertpos, spacing, flags and the line count did not. That native run was held before this contract existed; no save of it was observed.
